messages:
tara_devx: FYI user report: after following app-starter quickstart, their first /v1/generate POST opened the billing setup page in browser. They said they have trial credits.

oscar: That shouldn't happen. We should get a 402 JSON so UI can show CTA. Which client/agent?

tara_devx: local node starter, default proxy. They set REDWOOD_API_KEY from an invite.

billing-bot: log: workspace wks_ZX45 had trial_credits=50 but billing_method=null. API returned 402 `{"error":"billing_required"}` at 2026-03-25T11:20:01Z. Proxy then followed a 302 to /console/billing/setup.

infra_sam: Proxy libs (node-fetch/axios) follow redirects by default. We should change proxy to not follow 3xx for API routes, and have the browser fetch use `redirect: 'manual'`.

junior_dev: quick patch: in starter change fetch to `redirect:'manual'` and show a banner for 402 responses. Add unit test to assert no navigation.

oscar: Also investigate invite flow: invites sometimes create workspace without provisioning trial credits. @infra_sam can you open an ops ticket?

infra_sam: will file INC-2026-090 and include logs. Also adding an API contract test to assert JSON error bodies for programmatic clients.

tara_devx: Great. I'll notify the user with a workaround (use inviter's org key or set up billing) and follow up when PR lands. :thumbsup:
